integrity: The all-parameter proof is self-contained from the published code definition and Remark 5.2. A standalone exact verifier independently reconstructs the columns and exhausts all triples and quadruples for \(3\le m+1\le6\). The finite replay is a stress test, not a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the binary projective degree-two square-free code after puncturing the zero coordinates. It does not classify higher dual weights or nonbinary/higher-degree analogues. Literature searches leave a residual risk of an unindexed equivalent matroid formulation.
title: Minimum dual words of punctured binary quadratic projective square-free codes
